speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf. Against the notch. Mark me.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It wants a finger, mistress. Same as Friday.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A penny loaf, and a finger of it gone before grace. Sit. The firing is sixpence the week until Lady Day, and I am not buying a second loaf to comfort a feast.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will sit. I have a letter to write after, and I would eat first.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In Flanders the feast-bread was not larger. I have a loom in Norton Folgate, and I am here for the heel if you leave it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We will say grace over this one. It is the loaf we have. Gillis was out and back, and his shuttle is his own noise.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is it a feast, sir, if the bread is short?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a feast if someone has kept the day. The bread may do as it likes.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Candlemas. You said at breakfast the twins are ten.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten. Both of them. The paper will say so, and the paper will sit here till Thursday.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I could take it to the Bell this afternoon. I know the lane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You could, and Hobbins is not there. Thursday. Leave it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A letter that waits is still a letter. The cloth waits on the shuttle, and the cloth is made.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat. Threepence if you take the meat. The loaf is in the house, not on a bill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The meat. And I will not have a second loaf bought to mend a finger.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. I was not going to. Gib has already judged the crust, and Gib is a fool.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I cut it, or will you make a ceremony of a penny loaf?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cut it. The ceremony was at church.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Then I will take the heel. At the loom the heel was for the last man in. I am not last, and I will take it if you are tired of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You were at the door before the pudding. Take the heel if you like it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The pump in the close. Did it run? I would know the house is well before I write that it is.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It ran this morning. I had it for the pot. It complained, and it ran.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There. Write them that, if you must write a pump. And come to the meat while it is hot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will write the day, and the children, and not a sermon about a pump. Thursday for the letter. Not this afternoon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then eat, Master Shakespeare. The sixpence for the firing can wait on its own week. The meat will not.
